feeds.title: Rev. Ryk Brown
feeds.description: Rev. Ryk Brown, a multifaceted single parent and United Church of Canada Minister wears many hats: musician, motorcyclist, genealogist, and more. Managing ADHD and Bipolar without medication, he advocates for mental health, LGBTQ+ rights, and anti-bullying. Residing in Hamilton, Ontario, he champions productivity and faith-based mission development.

feeds.title: Dad Central » Single Dads
feeds.description: Dad Central, a beacon of fatherhood in Canada, boasts over 22 years of empowering dads. With firsthand experience and cutting-edge research, they offer invaluable resources and training, emphasizing the crucial role of fathers in child development. Dad Central: where fatherhood truly matters.

feeds.title: OneDadWithABlog
feeds.description: Andy Shapiera, a single dad with teens, explores the complexities of modern life with an open mind and strong opinions. From politics to hockey rivalries, his blog reflects diverse interests. With a Habs allegiance and a penchant for debate, he hopes to spark meaningful conversations and maybe even make a positive impact.
